response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_of_avg_length, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating) AS per_rating

assumptions.assumption: 'Costlier films with the threshold set at 20.99' means replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99 (not >=).
Films with a NULL rating are excluded, so only the rating groups are averaged. NULL length values are ignored by AVG, as the request says to ignore missing values.
